name: Approvals pending too long
query: N/A — would require a pending-age gauge, not a decision counter.
threshold: oldest open approval request > 24h since submission
notes: sacco_maker_checker_decisions_total only counts approved/rejected outcomes at the moment a decision is made (app/modules/maker_checker/service.py); it carries no information about requests still sitting open in 'pending'. This alert needs a new gauge — e.g. max/avg seconds-since-submission over platform.approval_requests / tenant.approval_requests rows where status='pending', computed per operation_type — which Phase 5 does not add (record_business_gauges has no such query). Not emitted anywhere in Phase 5; staged here so the gap is tracked.
